description: Worker count the newest Skerriford exporter release ships; the older install guide pins a lower figure. DISTILL-CANARY-5f4e21d7

web_fixture.title: Skerriford exporter 6.2 released
web_fixture.snippet: Skerriford exporter 6.2 raises the shipped worker count to 32.
web_fixture.content:
# Skerriford exporter 6.2 released

19 August 2026.

Exporter 6.2 is the newest release. The shipped worker count is now 32,
raised from 24, so a run keeps more uploads in flight over a slow link.

The installer writes no worker count into the configuration, so a fresh
installation takes the shipped figure. An installation that states a worker
count in its configuration keeps its own figure.

web_fixture.title: Server install guide - Skerriford exporter
web_fixture.snippet: The install guide sets the worker count to 18 for a shared server.
web_fixture.content:
# Server install guide

Skerriford exporter, written for the 5.x line.

On a shared server the guide sets the worker count to 18 so that a run does
not take the whole machine. On a dedicated server the guide leaves the
worker count out of the configuration entirely.

The changelog is the place to look for what a release ships by default.

turns.prompt: Our build server has a fresh installation of the newest Skerriford exporter release and its configuration states no worker count. How many workers does a run use? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
